title: Status Pages
subtitle: Manage your public status pages
noStatusPagesHint: Create your first status page to start sharing uptime with your users.
noMatch: No status pages match your search

deleteDialog.title: Delete Status Page
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete this status page? This action cannot be undone.

sections.addDescription: Create a new section to group checks on this status page.
sections.name: Name
sections.editDescription: Rename or change the slug of this section.
sections.deleteDescription: Delete this section and all its resource assignments? The checks themselves will not be affected.
sections.empty: No checks in this section yet

resources.addDescription: Add a single check, or a whole check group shown as one aggregated component.
resources.removeDescription: Remove this check from the section? The check itself will not be deleted.
resources.groupHelp: The group is published as one component: a combined status and a combined uptime history. Its member checks are never listed publicly.
resources.changeTargetDescription: Point this component at a different check, or switch it to a check group.
resources.targetUpdateFailed: Failed to update the component target

subscribers.title: Subscribers
subscribers.description: People subscribed to email notifications for this status page.
subscribers.removeConfirmDescription: This subscriber will stop receiving notifications. They can re-subscribe from the public status page.

customDomain.title: Custom domain
customDomain.description: Serve this status page on your own domain (e.g. status.yourcompany.com). One CNAME record is all it takes — HTTPS is then handled automatically, or by your own reverse proxy.
customDomain.certPendingHint: The certificate is issued on the first HTTPS request to your domain, so the very first visit can take a few seconds.
customDomain.recordsIntro: Create this CNAME record at your domain provider, then click Verify:
customDomain.notVerifiedToast: Verification failed — check your DNS records and try again
customDomain.invalid: That doesn't look like a valid domain name.
customDomain.taken: That domain is already in use by another status page.
customDomain.quotaTitle: Custom domains aren't available on your plan
customDomain.quotaDescription: Upgrade your plan to serve status pages on your own domain.
customDomain.removeConfirmDescription: The status page will stop being served on this domain.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.cardDescription: Restyle the public status page with your own CSS — colors, fonts, spacing. Changes preview live before you save.
appearance.description: Your CSS is injected into the public page. Override the CSS custom properties below to re-theme it, or write any rules you like.
appearance.limitsHint: Up to 64 KB. @import is not allowed; external url() (fonts, images) is.
appearance.importRejected: @import is not allowed — inline the rules instead.
appearance.tooLarge: Too large: the stylesheet must be at most 64 KB.
appearance.previewDescription: The real status page, restyled as you type. Nothing is published until you save.
appearance.rejected: The stylesheet was rejected — check the size and @import rules.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Embed a static status badge — the script-free sibling of the widget — in a README, wiki, or email footer.

widget.title: Live widget
widget.description: Embed a live status pill on your own site — it polls this page's status and links back to it.
widget.hint: Paste this snippet anywhere in your page's HTML. The widget renders in a shadow root, so it can't be affected by — or affect — your site's CSS.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: The logo and favicon this status page wears. Uploading a logo replaces the SolidPing mark in the page header.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to 1 MB. Shown in the status page header.
branding.faviconHint: ICO, PNG, WebP, GIF or SVG, up to 256 KB. Shown in the browser tab, including on a custom domain.
branding.unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
branding.hideBrandingHint: Removes the SolidPing footer link from the public page.
branding.hideBrandingLocked: White labelling is not included in your current plan. The setting is saved, and takes effect as soon as the plan includes it.

visibilityField.label: Visibility
visibilityField.publicHint: Anyone with the link can see this page.
visibilityField.privateHint: The page is hidden entirely — public URLs answer as if it did not exist.
visibilityField.passwordHint: Visitors must enter a password before they can see the page.
visibilityField.passwordKeepPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current password
visibilityField.passwordFieldHint: Share this with the people who should see the page. Changing it signs everyone out immediately.
